Title: Successfully fetch consolidated merchant onboarding data including active stores and terminal IDs
Preconditions: A user with ID 10001 is onboarded with completed KYC verification, an active merchant profile, an active merchant account, and at least one active store with registered terminals.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/v1/merchant-data with header 'AUTH_SUBJECT' set to '10001'.
2. Verify the HTTP response status and body content.

Test Data: Header: AUTH_SUBJECT = 10001
Expected Result: HTTP status 200 OK with success=true, message 'Merchant get data successfully', and payload containing kycData, merchant, merchantAccount, and store list where each active store includes its associated terminalIds.

Title: Successfully fetch merchant onboarding data for a merchant with active store having no registered terminals
Preconditions: A user with ID 10002 has verified KYC data and an active merchant profile with an active store that has no terminals assigned.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/v1/merchant-data with header 'AUTH_SUBJECT' set to '10002'.
2. Verify the HTTP response status code and data structure.

Test Data: Header: AUTH_SUBJECT = 10002
Expected Result: HTTP status 200 OK with success=true, message 'Merchant get data successfully', containing valid kycData, merchant, and store details with empty or null terminalIds list.

Title: Reject merchant data retrieval when Auth-Subject header contains non-numeric user ID
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/v1/merchant-data including request header Auth-Subject set to 'ABC_INVALID'.

Test Data: Header: Auth-Subject: ABC_INVALID
Expected Result: The request is rejected with HTTP status 400 Bad Request due to invalid numeric format for the authentication subject header.

Title: Reject merchant data retrieval when user ID does not exist in KYC records
Preconditions: No user or KYC verification record exists for user ID 999999.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/v1/merchant-data including request header Auth-Subject set to '999999'.

Test Data: Header: Auth-Subject: 999999
Expected Result: The request is rejected with a business error stating 'Couldn't find user. ID:999999'.

Title: Retrieve merchant data when merchant has zero active stores (empty store collection edge)
Preconditions: A user account exists in the KYC service with user ID 1001 and has an associated merchant account, but zero active stores are configured for this merchant.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/v1/merchant-data with header 'X-Auth-Subject: 1001'.

Test Data: Header X-Auth-Subject: 1001
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with success status and a response body containing KYC and merchant details, with the 'store' field set to an empty list [].

Title: Retrieve merchant data when an active store has zero assigned terminals (empty terminal list edge)
Preconditions: A user account exists in the KYC service with user ID 1002 and has an active store created, but zero terminals are assigned to that store.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/v1/merchant-data with header 'X-Auth-Subject: 1002'.

Test Data: Header X-Auth-Subject: 1002
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with response body containing 1 store entry where 'terminalIds' is null or an empty list.

Title: Retrieve merchant data using maximum allowed 64-bit integer user ID boundary value
Preconditions: A user account exists in the KYC system configured with the maximum 64-bit integer ID 9223372036854775807.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/v1/merchant-data with header 'X-Auth-Subject: 9223372036854775807'.

Test Data: Header X-Auth-Subject: 9223372036854775807
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response returning merchant data corresponding to user ID 9223372036854775807 without numeric parsing error.
